messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy started for service/auth-service in prod (helm) at 2026-07-01T12:10:00Z — revision v1.0.0

pagerduty-bot: PAGER: Maya (on-call) — PROD: auth-service CrashLoopBackOff on multiple pods; error budget threshold crossed

Maya: I'm on it. pulling the prod context and checking pods

Maya: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=auth-service
NAME                                    READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
auth-service-6f7d9c88b-2qk7p            0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   8          2m
auth-service-6f7d9c88b-4t9jn            1/1     Running            0          2m
auth-service-6f7d9c88b-7h8km            0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   7          2m
```

Maya: `kubectl describe pod auth-service-6f7d9c88b-2qk7p` shows readiness probe failing repeatedly

Maya: ```
Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404
path: /healthz
container: auth
Action: kubelet HTTP GET failed
```

Sam: That matches the chart change in the latest release — the helm value for `readiness.path` was accidentally changed to `/healthz`. The app expects `/readyz`.

Leo: Quick question — what's the customer impact right now?

Maya: From ingress/nginx logs: 5xx spike starting 12:11 UTC. Rough estimate ~2.1% of auth requests returned 5xx or timed out. No full outage but several customers reported login failures.

Tess: We have a feature flag `auth-new-flow` that gates some of the new code. Can we flip that to avoid rolling back?

Maya: I tried toggling the flag via the admin API, but the readiness probe path is baked into the container startup (config templating at build) — flipping the flag doesn't change the probe path. Flag toggle won't prevent kubelet from killing the pod due to failed readiness.

Sam: Ok, rollback is likely fastest. Helm rollback to previous revision (rev 42) should restore the prior chart values.

Sam: ```
$ helm history infra/auth-service -n prod
REVISION	UPDATED			STATUS		CHART		APP VERSION
42	2026-07-01T11:40:00Z	DEPLOYED	auth-0.9.1	1.9.2
43	2026-07-01T12:10:00Z	FAILED	auth-1.0.0	2.0.0
```

Maya: Executing: `helm rollback infra/auth-service 42 -n prod`

Maya: ```
Rollback was successful: deployed revision 42
Waiting for rollout...
$ kubectl rollout status deploy/auth-service -n prod
deployment "auth-service" successfully rolled out
```

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback completed for infra/auth-service to revision 42

pagerduty-bot: Resolved: alert auto-closure scheduled. Please confirm if any follow-ups are required.

Jay: Taking handoff for postmortem and customer comms. Short timeline: 
- 12:10 UTC: rev43 deployed (helm auth-1.0.0)
- 12:11 UTC: readiness probe failing (HTTP 404) -> pod CrashLoopBackOff
- 12:15 UTC: PagerDuty escalated, on-call triage started
- 12:18 UTC: rollback decision made
- 12:25 UTC: rollback complete, traffic normalized

Immediate next steps: owner for root-cause fix (helm value + chart validation), add a pre-deploy helm lint/helm test gate, verify feature flag semantics, and prepare a customer-facing note.

Jay: Who volunteers to own the RCA and the chart PR? @Sam @Tess?

Sam: I can own the chart fix and PR. I'll add a sentinel helm test and enforce `readiness.path` validation in the chart values schema.

Tess: I'll draft the customer-facing note and coordinate with comms, and verify affected tenants.

Maya: I'll upload pod logs, readiness probe failure traces, and the kubelet events to the incident board.

Leo: Assigning follow-ups: postmortem doc + backlog items. Jay will be the incident owner to publish the RCA.

Jay: ack, I'll open the postmortem doc and set owners. Thanks all for quick reaction. :thumbsup:

Maya: marking mitigated and closing the live thread.
